title: Offline audit of Gate 16 grounding, correctness, and latency metrics

entry.pytest_basetemp: external directory outside the Git root

frozen_input.gate16_artifact: existing Gate 16 G5 cfg3 artifact; read-only

grounding.operational_frozen_definition: Use the implementation's exact unique-cited-id numerator and denominator after the implementation is read. For the audit, a cited chunk is manually grounded when its stored text supports the answer; membership in relevant_chunk_ids is not required.
grounding.annotation_false_negative_is_numeric: At least 1 cited chunk on a hand-correct answer is implementation-ungrounded solely because it is absent from relevant_chunk_ids, and manual adjudication marks it supporting.
grounding.metric_defective_if: The annotation false-negative count is at least 1 and the manually corrected precision or recall changes by at least 1 percentage point, or the unchanged Gate 12-V verdict changes.
grounding.correction_scope: Audit all cited unique chunk ids on the 26 hand-correct rows. Report the 26-row hand-audited counts separately from any all-36-row Gate 16 re-application; do not infer un-audited rows as corrected.
grounding.genuine_failure: A cited chunk whose stored text does not support the hand-correct answer, including a citation that is only topically related or supports a different claim.

correctness.hand_reference: The 36 Gate 16 answerable rows and the frozen hand labels recorded in the Gate 16 result.
correctness.metric_defective_if: The automated label disagrees with the hand label on at least 1 of 36 answerable rows; report disagreement as a raw count and rate, and classify false negatives versus false positives.
correctness.viability_rule: Recommend the automated metric as viable only if it has zero hand-label disagreements on this frozen corpus; otherwise hand adjudication remains the reference for this corpus.

latency.sample: The existing Gate 16 G5 end-to-end latency values for the 38 provider-attempted rows.

bootstrap.statistic: p95 using the registered floor((n-1)*p) index rule

latency.noise_rule: Call the 508.479 ms miss measurement-noise-compatible when 30000 ms lies inside the pre-registered 95% bootstrap interval for p95; otherwise name the observed tail cause and do not call it noise.

outputs: addendum to gates/results/GATE_16_RESULT.md when a Gate 16 number is corrected
addendum to gates/results/GATE_12V_RESULT.md when a Gate 12-V number is corrected
protocol_sha256: computed after commit over the canonical file bytes
